author: t. j. gough
title: Baylor men's tennis secures eighth straight win with 4-0 victory over Texas Tech
text:
Baylor men’s tennis extended its winning streak to eight matches after defeating No. 70 Texas Tech with a 4-0 sweep on April 9 in Lubbock.
The victory improves Baylor’s record to 18-7 overall and 6-1 in Big 12 play as the team approaches the end of the regular season. The Bears’ strong performance puts them in a favorable position heading into upcoming conference matchups.
In doubles competition, Texas Tech took an early lead when Niksa Arsic and Thiago Guglieri defeated Alexandru Chirita and Zsombor Velcz, 6-3. Baylor responded with Devin Badenhorst and Calvin Baierl winning their match by the same score. The decisive doubles point came down to Court Two, where Connor Van Schalkwyk and Luc Koenig edged out Tyler Stewart and Sebastian Abboud in a tiebreaker, finishing 7-6(3) to secure the first point for Baylor.
During singles play, Baylor maintained control by winning first sets on five courts. Koenig earned the second point for Baylor by beating Guglieri, 6-4, 6-3. Van Schalkwyk followed closely behind with a straight-set win on Court Three, defeating Ludovico Vaccari, 6-3, 6-4. Velcz clinched the final point for Baylor by overcoming Stewart with a score of 6-4, 6-3.
Looking ahead, Baylor will return home to Waco for a doubleheader on Sunday against No. 4 TCU at 1:00 p.m., followed by UTGRV at 6:00 p.m., marking Senior Day for the team.
The continued success of Baylor’s men’s tennis program highlights their momentum as they approach key matches that could impact their standing within the Big 12.
